requirements.title: Customer Master
requirements.statement: Customer records with name, industry, location, contacts grouped by department, and approved vendor status per operator.

requirements.title: Supplier / Principal Master
requirements.statement: Principal records with manufacturer, contact, approved makes, lead time, pricing (restricted) and certifications.

requirements.title: End-User Product Approval
requirements.statement: Track each product's approval per operator: agreement signing, document submission, audit, until approved or rejected.

requirements.title: Opportunity / Project
requirements.statement: Opportunities carry tender stage, probability, competitors and expected value.

requirements.title: Enquiry / RFQ
requirements.statement: RFQs carry RFQ number, date, customer, project, items, quantities and deadline.

requirements.title: Quotation
requirements.statement: Quotations carry number, principal cost, selling price, margin, validity, Incoterms and delivery terms.

requirements.title: Offer Follow-Ups
requirements.statement: Every quotation is tracked from submission to PO, with follow-ups.

requirements.title: Technical Clarifications
requirements.statement: Technical queries are tracked with customer comments, TQ status, drawings, datasheets and approvals.

requirements.title: Commercial Negotiation
requirements.statement: Initial, revised, discount and target prices are recorded with their history.

requirements.title: Profit Optimization
requirements.statement: Historical cost and price data can be reviewed to optimise margin.

requirements.title: PO Management
requirements.statement: Customer POs carry PO number, value, delivery date, payment terms and status, checked against the quotation.

requirements.title: Commission Management
requirements.statement: Commission orders (buyer orders direct from the principal, about 3% commission) are tracked with progress, commission invoicing and payment realisation, separate from own-account orders.

requirements.title: Post-Order Document Approval
requirements.statement: Post-order documents (ITP, GAD, MTC, WPS/PQR, inspection, deviations) are tracked to client approval before goods move.

requirements.title: Delivery Tracking
requirements.statement: Delivery is tracked through production, inspection, RFI, shipping, customs and delivery to site.

requirements.title: Receivables
requirements.statement: Invoices are tracked with due date, payment status and outstanding amount; the principal is paid back to back.

requirements.title: After-Sales
requirements.statement: Complaints, warranty, replacements and customer feedback are tracked.

requirements.title: Reports / Dashboards
requirements.statement: Reports on pipeline, won/lost RFQs, margins, pending deliveries and receivables, with notifications.

requirements.title: Role and field-level access
requirements.statement: Role-based access with field-level permissions; cost, margin, commission and principal pricing visible only to named users.

requirements.title: Two-factor authentication
requirements.statement: Two-factor login.

requirements.title: Audit trail
requirements.statement: Changes to sensitive records (pricing, margins, deal values, contact details) are logged.

requirements.title: Export controls
requirements.statement: Bulk export and download restricted.

requirements.title: Data migration
requirements.statement: Existing customer, supplier and historical tender and order records are migrated.

requirements.title: Training
requirements.statement: Training for users and administrators.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.statement: Support after go-live, with response times.
